---
fig-width: 1e2
fig-height: .inf
fig-asp: 1_000
columns: 2
dpi: 96
number-offset: [1, 2]
toc-expand: true
linestretch: 2em
execute:
  daemon: 30
  daemon-restart: false
format:
  html:
    fig-dpi: 300
    toc-depth: 3
---

Every value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33 AND is a value the
numeric matcher accepts, so the feature must produce ZERO diagnostics — the FP guard
battery (numeric plan §4.1 L3):
`fig-width: 1e2` / `fig-height: .inf` / `fig-asp: 1_000` are exotic YAML number
literals (exponent, infinity, digit-group underscore) — kept on genuinely-FLOAT fields
so they satisfy BOTH the quarto-schema layer and pandoc (integer-conceptual fields like
`dpi`/`columns` pandoc-reject a float/`.inf`, numeric plan §2.4). `columns: 2` / `dpi: 96`
are in-range ints. `number-offset: [1, 2]` is the ARRAY form — skip-guarded by the
matcher's leading-`[` guard, never flagged. `toc-expand: true` is the BOOLEAN form of a
number-OR-boolean field; `execute.daemon: 30` is its NUMBER form. `linestretch: 2em` is a
MIXED number|string field — its string form must NOT be flagged (open, numeric plan §7.4).
The per-format `fig-dpi: 300` / `toc-depth: 3` are valid per-format numbers. The cell
`#| fig-width: 6  # a trailing comment` exercises the unquoted-comment strip.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6  # a trailing comment
#| layout-ncol: 2
1 + 1
```
